newsitem.title: USA: First America buys financial services firm.
newsitem.headline: First America buys financial services firm.

text.p: First of America Bank Corp said it bought financial services firm Scott, Doerschler, Messner & Gauntlett for undisclosed terms.

Scott, Doerschler, based in Kalamazoo, has 28 employees who specialize in business life insurance, executive benefits, estate planning, financial planning and employee benefits. It has about 300 business clients and more than 2,000 individual clients, First of America said.
The bank holding company intends to retain Scott Doerschler's name, management and location.
